CLOUD FIXER seat for PR #2798 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head b85b5f37667839ea2fe88fa23b18ce10b9486b20. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch b85b5f37667839ea2fe88fa23b18ce10b9486b20 for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-rca-merge-subject-class-open-r3, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-rca-merge-subject-class-open-r3 <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-rca-merge-subject-class-open-r3; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Body-only fixer, round 3, for root-cause PR #2798 (branch fix/r10-rca-merge-subject-class-open, PR head 7c64db1b3ee50453bf3f5d12055d6a2bca8baeb7; code handoff handoff/r10-rca-merge-subject-class-open-r2 at b85b5f37667839ea2fe88fa23b18ce10b9486b20, body ref handoff-body/r10-rca-merge-subject-class-open-r2). Roster carries are at R10-MERGE-SUBJECT-HARDEN 3cd2bab6a and R10-MERGE-SUBJECT-CASEARM 00ceb9aa4 on handoff/audit-r10-roster (carry file carries/carry-2798-merge-subject-class-open.md); read origin/verdict/2798 for the earlier block.
Defect: the r2 body (handoff-body/r10-rca-merge-subject-class-open-r2) is refused by update_pr.sh at its prepr step with `CI PREDICT: 1 predicted red(s) on pr-contract` and `CARRY UNROUTED item 5c134965: 'Read back: ...'`. That is line 44 of the body, the `Read back:` sentence in `## Forward-carry` (run `python3 -I tools/audit/carry_audit.py check` over the body, or tools/pr/prepr.sh --body-check, to reproduce). The carry audit reads it as a carry item with no destination.
Repair: re-take the whole body (never a subset) and change only that sentence so it is no longer an unrouted carry item: either route it with a destination the audit accepts, or state it as a plain verification note outside the carry list, whichever carry_audit.py's grammar (read its parser first) treats correctly. Do not drop the content it states. Re-push handoff/r10-rca-merge-subject-class-open-r3 at b85b5f37667839ea2fe88fa23b18ce10b9486b20 unchanged (no code, no record edit), then the body with body_push.sh r10-rca-merge-subject-class-open-r3. Before pushing, run prepr --body-check to green and `node tools/policy/figure_lint.mjs --pr-body <body> --at origin/handoff/r10-rca-merge-subject-class-open-r3` (0 refused). Ledger keys in plain text, not a code span.
No host or home paths in anything you push; cite repo-relative paths only.
